notes: Positive: in-the-moment investigation requests (perf issue, intermittent, mystery bug, regression). Negative: post-incident RCA (→ bug-analysis), implementation, code review, threat model. Edge: investigation where root cause is found mid-stream (→ hand to bug-analysis); flaky test debugging.

cases.query: Why is our /checkout endpoint slow today? Investigate
Debug this intermittent 504 — happens for ~3% of requests
Find the regression — auth-svc was working last week, broken now. Git bisect
Mystery bug: works on my machine but fails in staging. Help me investigate
Structured debugging on this race condition — hypothesis-driven approach please
Depura esto — el endpoint está fallando intermitentemente y no sé por qué
I have a 50MB JSON file that crashes our parser — help me minimise it (delta debugging)
Performance regression after the v1.42 deploy — locate the commit and the cause
Write the RCA for the outage we resolved yesterday — root cause is already known
cases.notes: Post-incident RCA = bug-analysis; debugging-protocol fires only while cause is unknown.

cases.query: Implement the fix for the discount-leak bug
Review this PR — does it introduce any obvious bugs?
Design the architecture for a fraud-detection service
Split this bug-fix task into smaller pieces — it's too big for one PR
Write the test plan for the upcoming release
Document this bug we found — write up a Jira ticket description
I think I found the cause mid-investigation — should I keep digging or hand off?
cases.notes: Skill fires; output instructs handing to bug-analysis once root cause is confirmed.

cases.query: Debug this flaky test — fails ~10% of the time, no clear reason
We have a customer-reported bug but can't reproduce it locally — help
